title: LCARS Shell Dashboard Strategy
description: Dashboard strategy that generates a full LCARS shell (header, sidebars, content panel) on a custom:lcards-layout-view. Set it as the dashboard's `strategy:` block. The room light list needs auto-entities (HACS).

room_selector_entity.title: Room Controller Entity
room_selector_entity.description: Controls the room light controller. input_select or select: its options become the room list (entity mode). input_text: room list is built from your HA area registry automatically; the selected area is stored in this entity (auto-areas mode). Leave blank to show a placeholder.

page_selector_entity.title: Page Selector Entity
page_selector_entity.description: input_select entity used for sidebar page/section navigation

top_bar_entity.title: Top Bar Toggle
top_bar_entity.description: input_boolean that shows/hides the top header bar (also bound to the first header-left button)

right_sidebar_entity.title: Right Sidebar Toggle
right_sidebar_entity.description: input_boolean that shows/hides the right sidebar (also bound to the second header-left button)
